task.title: P6-187: [parked] Candidate.index and nav.highlighted() may index different spaces
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Parked — real, deliberately deferred; do not work until its trigger fires). Original id: P6-187. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**`Candidate.index` and `nav.highlighted()` index different spaces** (was `P6-069j`) — the first is a position within its own result set, the second indexes the whole registry, so if two result sets are ever briefly co-registered during a swap they disagree and two chips render. **Verification could not settle whether that window exists; the check is a DOM inspection during a rapid query swap.**

**Trigger: a reported double-highlight or double chip.**
